decisionRationale: The exact 492-report collection covers expression, head_pitch, head_roll, and head_yaw. Head-roll evidence now includes six canonical metric-geometry reports across three manual subject-linkage groups, including four supplemental reports from the user-supplied triplets. For this internal research track, source authorization and same-session provenance are recorded as limitations but are explicitly not used as adequacy blockers. The evidence is therefore accepted as adequate for a provisional same-provider research normalization candidate only; no Production, threshold, Archetype, or style authority is granted.
coverageLimitations: Four supplemental head-roll observations come from user-supplied internet imagery; same-session capture provenance is unverified and retained as a documented limitation rather than a research gate.
Research-use authorization for the supplemental imagery is unverified and retained as a documented limitation rather than a research gate.
Observed drift is descriptive and uncalibrated; no numeric adequacy threshold is applied or implied.
Cross-provider semantic alignment is outside this adequacy review; existing semantic holds, including chin_height_ratio and nose_width_ratio, remain unresolved.
